==Notes==
*This attack skill causes the attack to deal lightning damage as opposed to only the bonus damage being lightning damage as stated by the skill description.
**[[Conjure Lightning]]'s bonus damage will trigger for this attack.
*Spear of Lightning and [[Lightning Javelin]] are the only two skills that uses this line-shaped area of effect. 
**Using the skill counts as an attack only against the target (the listed lightning damage is added to the spear's base damage, and the attack is affected by [[blocking]], [[blind]], [[weapon spell]]s, and other effects). All other enemies are dealt the listed lightning damage as a separate instance.
